waypoints.name: Alpental Ski Area parking lot / Snow Lake Trailhead
waypoints.note: Same trailhead used for all Chair Peak-area routes; from here the traverse goes via Source Lake toward Pineapple Pass and Bryant Col rather than directly up Snow Lake Trail.
waypoints.directions: From I-90 take Exit 52 (Snoqualmie Pass West) and turn left (north), passing under the freeway. Take the second right onto Alpental Road and drive about 1.3 miles to its end at the Alpental Ski Area parking lot, at about 3,100 ft, where the Snow Lake Trail #1013 starts. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park, and a free self-issue wilderness permit is required.
